source_constraint: Use bundled diagnosis guidance, approved anonymous public Nexus SDK, Nexus Move Packages, and pinned Sui framework sources, repository-owned fixtures, published Nexus documentation for version-sensitive setup, and explicit read-only Sui Testnet evidence. Do not use private or unbundled sources, credentials, wallets, or mutations.

evals.prompt: Use the $nexus-onchain-task-debugging skill. Diagnose a pending Execution with a retained result and a payment shortfall. Read Task, Occurrence, Execution, Invocation/result, and payment evidence in order and separate authorization, committed result, reserve, ExecutionPayment, Tool charge, refund, and gas.
evals.expected_output: A complete component matrix and cause ledger with exact identities, evidence classes, every confirmed, ruled-out, or unresolved cause, and safe next reads for all evidence gaps.
expectations: The report does not infer a relationship from a name, FQN, timestamp, or payment ID alone.
It inspects the historical DAG/configuration and supplied/effective inputs even though the prompt already names a payment shortfall.
It lists every applicable identity, configuration, DAG, input, lifecycle, Tool/result, authorization, and payment cause as confirmed, ruled out, or unresolved from exact on-chain evidence.
It distinguishes read-only diagnosis from refill, settlement, abort, close, retry, or scheduling mutations.
It records checkpoint/transaction provenance and response digests when available.

evals.prompt: Collect public package, module, and object observations for a Task diagnosis from https://graphql.testnet.sui.io/graphql. Reject unsupported methods, malformed responses, non-testnet endpoints, and missing identifiers before interpreting state.
evals.expected_output: A bounded read-only testnet report or a concrete unavailable-evidence failure; no state-changing fallback.
expectations: The endpoint and network identity are explicit in the report.
Only allowlisted read-only GraphQL queries are sent for the shown GraphQL endpoint.
The report states that public-state evidence does not prove execution or settlement.

evals.prompt: Diagnose an Execution whose on-chain history contains a walk request followed by a Leader timeout. Inspect the exact historical DAG and configuration, every supplied and effective input, Invocation/result and authorization records, Task funding, ExecutionPayment, Tool charges, refunds, priority fee, and native SUI gas. List all possible protocol-record causes without guessing what any Leader, Tool, scheduler, SDK, or external service did off chain.
evals.expected_output: A complete component matrix and cause ledger that classifies every applicable invariant failure as confirmed, ruled out, or unresolved using exact on-chain object/event/effect evidence and names each missing read.
expectations: A walk-request event is treated only as dispatch evidence and a Leader timeout only as a recorded outcome, not as proof of complete inputs, Tool execution, or Leader fault.
DAG entry-group values, defaults, edges, Tool bindings, and port schemas are reconciled against every supplied/effective input and Invocation commitment.
Task funding, ExecutionPayment, Tool charge, refund, priority fee, recipients, settlement, and native SUI gas remain separate cause rows.
No cause is described as likely or probable; exact conflicts are confirmed, fully satisfied invariants are ruled out, and missing or non-exposing reads remain unresolved.
The diagnosis continues through independent required reads after finding a conflict and does not stop at the first plausible cause.

evals.prompt: Implement a Sui Move Tool with a public execute ABI, witness object, verified authorization, and tagged output. Local Move tests are authorized and no Execution diagnosis is requested.
evals.expected_output: The on-chain Tool development skill is selected; exhaustive Task diagnosis is not triggered.
expectations: The request routes to Move Tool authoring rather than on-chain Execution diagnosis.
No on-chain Task, DAG, input, or payment cause ledger is invented.

evals.prompt: Create a Rust HTTP Tool for a weather provider with bounded injectable I/O, externally tagged outputs, signed HTTP replay checks, and key-free metadata. No pending or failed Nexus Execution needs diagnosis.
evals.expected_output: The off-chain Tool skill is selected; exhaustive on-chain Task diagnosis is not triggered.
expectations: The request routes to off-chain Tool development rather than an Execution cause ledger.
No Task, DAG, input, authorization, or payment evidence is invented.
